about: Lawrence H. Jacobson is not only a highly experienced real estate attorney and litigation consultant but he is also a well-respected expert witness in civil trials throughout Southern California. His expertise includes real estate, legal malpractice and broker malpractice issues.

The Law Offices of Lawrence H. Jacobson, A Professional Corporation, is located in Beverly Hills. However, the law firm serves businesses and individuals throughout Southern Califoria, primarily in Orange County, Ventura County, Los Angeles County and the surrounding areas who have cases involving legal malpractice in ethics, legal fee disputes, real estate and business transactions, succession planning, interpretation of real estate documents and real estate and mortgage broker standard of care.

Mr. Jacobson has been practicing law for almost 50 years, having served as an expert witness for over 35 years. He has lectured extensively on real estate matters and published numerous professional articles. He is also the former president of the Association of Real Estate Attorneys, the former vice president of legal affairs for the California Association of Realtors, and the Past President of the Beverly Hills Bar Association.
Mr. Jacobson earned his juris doctorate from the University of California at Los Angeles School of Law in 1967.
